case: B — INVALID: the conditional restart block sits in the same undifferentiated executable queue as the core treatment blocks, with no conditional gate

what_is_wrong.statement: the frozen schedule generator was invoked with the full six-block list, so the conditional RESTART_CONTRAST block was serialized into the executable queue without any gate distinguishing it from the five unconditional core blocks
what_is_wrong.consequence: a treatment executor consuming this artifact naively would run 72 treatment trials instead of the 60 the protocol authorises at this stage, and would run the restart contrast BEFORE the frozen direct-positive gate has been evaluated
what_is_wrong.the_protocol_rule_violated: RESTART_CONTRAST is unlocked only after the frozen direct-positive condition is met; it must not enter the currently executable queue
what_is_wrong.introduced_by: this run's schedule invocation (D1_BLOCKS passed whole); the frozen generators themselves are unchanged

why_no_correction_was_applied_here: the schedule is frozen and its hash is recorded; correcting it is a prospective schedule decision that must be handled separately, with its own amendment and its own hash, rather than by filtering at execution time and claiming the original schedule was correct

noise_rule_preservation.note: treatment scoring must still require the between-level disagreement to exceed the frozen Wilson upper bound AND reach delta_min

required_next_step: decide, as a prospective schedule amendment, how the conditional block is gated (for example an explicit block-level 'unlock_condition' with the frozen direct-positive predicate, and an executable flag that is false at freeze time)
re-freeze the schedule with its own new hash and record the superseded hash rather than editing it in place
only then may treatment run, and only for the currently authorised blocks
